title: MALT：搜索树成败归因账（期望回传 + 0.5 严格阈值 + 同父偏好配对）
title_en: MALT: Search-Tree Credit Attribution Ledger (Expectation Backprop + Strict 0.5 Threshold + Same-Parent Preference Pairing)
source: arXiv:2412.01928 (COLM 2025 v3) sec 4.2 / A.6.1 -- paper-formula oracle (no official code release)
source_lines: 论文公式：V(r_{j,k,l})=R∈{0,1}、V(v_{j,k})=(1/n)Σ_l V(r)、V(g_j)=(1/n)Σ_k V(v)、θ=0.5 严格二值化、D_R/D_V/D_G 同父配对定义
description: MALT 的核心主张：多智能体 Generate→Verify→Refine 流水线的信用分配不该只看终局对错——把每题的 n³ 条采样轨迹组织成三层搜索树，用**值迭代**（自下而上的兄弟期望，无折扣因子）把稀疏的叶奖励回传到每个中间节点，再以 0.5 严格阈值二值化（对齐多数投票），最后按**同父上下文**构造 DPO 偏好对。官方无开源实现，口径 = 论文公式唯一确定的算术账（叶奖励与树结构全部显式入参），五入口复刻：propagate——V(v_{j,k})=(1/n)Σ_l V(r_{j,k,l})、V(g_j)=(1/n)Σ_k V(v_{j,k})，均为对直接子节点的 Monte Carlo 样本均值，树形 n×n×n 校验；binarize——V>θ 记 ✓、**恰等于 θ（含 0.5）记 ×**；pairs——同父内正子集×负子集的全组合 (r⁺,r⁻)（正下标在前、父下标升序）：D_R 在同一 verifier 输出下、D_V 在同一 generator 输出下、D_G 在同题下（论文定义了 D_G 但 Generator 只做 SFT 不做 DPO）；sft——R 层取 V(r)=1、V/G 层取二值 ✓ 的正样本（保持输入顺序）+ 逐父 (正数,负数) 对账；attribute——单题全流程组装（线性下标编码 j*n*n+k*n+l）。
description_en: MALT's core claim: credit assignment for the multi-agent Generate→Verify→Refine pipeline should not look only at the final outcome — organize each question's n³ sampled trajectories into a three-level search tree, propagate the sparse leaf rewards back to every intermediate node via **value iteration** (bottom-up expectations over siblings, no discount factor), binarize with a strict 0.5 threshold (majority-vote alignment), and build DPO preference pairs within the **shared parent context**. The official code is unreleased; the oracle is the paper formula's unique deterministic arithmetic (leaf rewards and the tree structure are all explicit inputs), replicated via five solve entries: propagate — V(v_{j,k})=(1/n)Σ_l V(r_{j,k,l}) and V(g_j)=(1/n)Σ_k V(v_{j,k}), both Monte Carlo sample means over direct children, with an n×n×n shape check; binarize — V>θ is correct and **V==θ (including 0.5) is incorrect**; pairs — the full positive-subset × negative-subset combination (r⁺,r⁻) within each parent (positive index first, parents ascending): D_R under the same verifier output, D_V under the same generator output, D_G under the same question (the paper defines D_G but the Generator trains SFT-only, no DPO); sft — R-layer positives are V(r)=1 while V/G layers take binarized ✓ outputs (input order preserved) plus a per-parent (positive, negative) tally; attribute — the full per-question assembly (linear index encoding j*n*n+k*n+l).
notes: 官方账的关键细节（论文口径钉死，官方无开源代码——沙箱 oracle 是论文公式的独立 numpy 直译 + 手工锚点）：(1) **无折扣因子**：值迭代就是两层样本均值（V(v)=mean of leaves、V(g)=mean of V(v)），树深只有 3，论文公式无 γ 项——todos 里旧候选描述的「深度折扣」经回源修正为不存在。(2) **0.5 阈值是严格大于**：论文原文 'values greater than 0.5 are labeled as correct (✓), and those with values less than or equal to 0.5 are labeled as incorrect (×)'——n 为偶数时兄弟均值可恰取 0.5（TREE_B 的 v00=v01=g0=0.5 全判 ×）；n=3 时分子∈{0..3} 除以 3 取不到 0.5，边界只在 n 偶数时出现。(3) **配对是同父上下文**：D_R 的正负必须共享同一 (q,g,v) 前缀（论文原文 'for the same verifier input v_{i,j,k}'）、D_V 共享同一 g_{i,j}、D_G 同题——**不是跨分支笛卡尔积**；同父内是正子集×负子集的全部组合（1 正 2 负出 2 对，2 正 2 负出 4 对）。(4) **Generator 只 SFT**：论文定义了 D_G（同题正负 g 配对）但明确 'For the Generator, we opt for SFT-only because DPO does not improve performance'——本题仍构造 D_G 以钉定义。(5) SFT 正样本的取值口径分层不同：R 层用叶奖励本身（V(r)=1），V/G 层用二值化 label（v̂=✓）——V(g)>0.5 的 g 进 SFT 而 V(g)∈(0,0.5] 的不进。(6) 线性下标编码：r 叶 (j,k,l) → j*n*n+k*n+l、v (j,k) → j*n+k、g → j；pairs 返回 (正下标, 负下标) 对而非文本（文本是模型生成，不入题）。(7) 树形校验：rewards 必须 n×n×n 否则 ValueError——分支因子是显式入参（论文实验 n=3 → 每题 27 轨迹）。(8) 与 782 to-gmpo / 787 rl-ktae 划界：那些是 advantage/loss 侧的既有 GRPO 族账；本题是**数据构造侧**——树形期望回传产出角色特定的 SFT/DPO 数据集，产物直接喂 DPO 损失（损失侧已占不重做）。(9) 与 784 VinePPO 划界：VinePPO 的 MC 值是每步 k 条续采的均值作 value 基线；MALT 的期望回传是树形兄弟均值作数据标签，且叶奖励来自终局判卷而非逐步回报。
notes_en: Key paper-pinned details (no official code release — the sandbox oracle is an independent NumPy translation of the paper formulas plus hand-computed anchors): (1) **no discount factor**: the value iteration is just two levels of sample means (V(v)=mean of leaves, V(g)=mean of V(v)); the tree is only 3 deep and the paper formulas carry no γ — the old candidate description's 'depth discount' is corrected to nonexistent after sourcing. (2) **the 0.5 threshold is strictly greater**: paper text 'values greater than 0.5 are labeled as correct (✓), and those with values less than or equal to 0.5 are labeled as incorrect (×)' — with even n the sibling mean can hit exactly 0.5 (TREE_B's v00=v01=g0=0.5 all judged ×); with n=3 the numerator ∈{0..3} over 3 never yields 0.5, so the boundary only appears for even n. (3) **pairing is same-parent**: D_R's positive and negative must share the same (q,g,v) prefix (paper text 'for the same verifier input v_{i,j,k}'), D_V shares g_{i,j}, D_G the question — **never a cross-branch cartesian product**; within a parent it is the full positive-subset × negative-subset combination (1 positive × 2 negatives gives 2 pairs, 2×2 gives 4). (4) **the Generator is SFT-only**: the paper defines D_G (same-question positive/negative g pairs) but states 'For the Generator, we opt for SFT-only because DPO does not improve performance' — this problem still constructs D_G to pin the definition. (5) The SFT-positive value criterion differs per layer: R uses the leaf reward itself (V(r)=1) while V/G use the binarized label (v̂=✓) — a g with V(g)>0.5 enters SFT and one with V(g)∈(0,0.5] does not. (6) Linear index encoding: r leaf (j,k,l) → j*n*n+k*n+l, v (j,k) → j*n+k, g → j; pairs return (positive index, negative index) rather than text (the text is model-generated and stays out of the problem). (7) Shape check: rewards must be n×n×n or ValueError — the branching factor is an explicit input (paper experiments use n=3 → 27 trajectories per question). (8) Boundary vs 782 to-gmpo / 787 rl-ktae: those are the existing GRPO-family accounts on the advantage/loss side; this problem is **data construction** — the tree expectation backprop yields role-specific SFT/DPO datasets whose products feed the DPO loss directly (the loss side is already taken and not redone). (9) Boundary vs 784 VinePPO: VinePPO's MC value is the mean of k per-step continuations serving as a value baseline; MALT's expectation backprop is a tree sibling mean serving as a data label, with leaf rewards coming from final-answer grading rather than per-step returns.
